[USER] User inquired about popular learning models in US high schools.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant listed several learning models popular in US high schools:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Traditional Classroom Model: Involves teachers delivering lectures and students taking notes and completing assignments.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Flipped Classroom Model: Students learn course material at home and use class time for discussions and activities.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Personalized Learning Model: Allows students to work at their own pace and choose their learning paths with individualized support.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Blended Learning Model: Combines traditional instruction with online learning.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Mastery-Based Learning Model: Students must demonstrate mastery of a concept before progressing.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Project-Based Learning Model: Involves real-world projects requiring critical thinking and collaboration.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Each model has its own benefits and drawbacks, and schools may adopt a combination of models.
